selection_policy: Six exact owners and existing explicitly linked banks/levels only. Condition-only unsaved canonical-theory clones. A-E use primary type-four thematic pools; F uses the existing linked FinalDrillA2 bank for program breadth, without changing any final-drill model, membership, requirements, progress or endpoint. Original answers/options/hints and native formatter/casing/score remain unchanged; this draft is not browser acceptance.
coverage_before_selection: A: finished-time event, already, yet, since and gone/nonreturn. Own tasks also test been-in and returned been-to; no invented arrival implication.
B: information agreement, how many, little, explicit one advice unit and homework. Own tasks preserve servings and reject automatic a-few sufficiency.
C: time, place, depend-on, interested-in and listen-to; own tasks cover entry, correct jump-in and no destination-to-arrival inference.
D: all four retained groups plus bounded finished-event diagnosis: modal perfect, conditional, concession and initial negative inversion. Formal depth is retained without retagging old bank levels.

E: five different functions in be/profession, possession, routine, article and ability. Own six tasks add have-got question, quantity, aspect contrast, comparison, past event and will purchase. Not full CEFR/course assessment; other source models remain in visible basic and original navigation.

F: existing linked FinalDrillA2 selection adds going-to, should, decide+infinitive, past process and used-to. Own six tasks cover perfect, tag, obligation, conditional meaning, reported roles and passive agent. Relative/gerund/time-expression submodels remain visible but are not claimed individually graded by eleven questions.
